boundary_statement: Plugins, MCP connectors, and skills are capability surfaces. They are not consent, not proof, and not publication authority.

allowed_without_extra_approval: reuse local templates in curated artifacts

blocked_claims: plugin response is durable receipt without artifact

allowed_without_extra_approval: record server instruction summary when safe
blocked_claims: MCP server instruction overrides project safety
connector write is implied by prior broad permission

allowed_without_extra_approval: read when specifically needed and privacy-safe
blocked_claims: cloud mirror is canon without repo receipt
Drive upload is safe by default

publication_requirements: state whether a source is local evidence, external context, or advisory
record any mutation-capable surface as blocked unless explicitly approved
include no_gmut_validation_import in THOS phase manifests
do not stage raw connector output
do not quote sibling advisories as if they were independent receipts
next_phase_use: v470_THOS_v1_x2 should convert each boundary rule into a lint predicate.
